name: humboldti-note
description: A minimal daily markdown note-taking tool for your terminal.
long_description: Exposes your daily notes to Claude over MCP: search_notes, read_note, append_note, and recent_notes. Notes are plain markdown files under your notes directory (default ~/notes) -- no database, no lock-in.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes with a case-insensitive regular expression (at most 100 matching lines, newest first).

tools.name: recent_notes
tools.description: Read the last few days of notes (default 7) as markdown.
